decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building is occupied).

Condition : 4 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of    0900  to   1700   on Mondays to Friday and none shall take place on weekends and public holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The windows formed in the flank  elevation shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 6 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the rear and flank walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of roof extension to dwellinghouse
